title: schedonorus varius
intro: Schedonorus varius, commonly known as Timothy grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family and is native to Europe and Asia. It is a perennial grass that has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving symptoms of allergies and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Timothy grass are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal supplements. The bioactive constituents of Timothy grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
